application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.source: https://github.com/BatICM/battery-charging-data-of-on-road-electric-vehicles, README, section 'battery pack information update' ("equipped with CATL NCM batteries")
chemistry.note: Stated by the data record (CATL NCM). The paper does not name it.

cells_liion.source: 20 release packs x 90 series cells stated in the release metadata

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: The charging CSVs expose pack extrema, not individual cell channels.

energy_mwh.source: 20 packs x 90 cells x 145 Ah x 3.65 V / 1,000,000
energy_mwh.note: The 3.65 V cell voltage is assumed, not stated; measured mid-SOC voltage is 3.71 V at low current and 3.76 V under charge (source audit 2026-10-04), which would give 0.966 MWh at 3.7 V.

energy_basis.source: energy_mwh is computed from stated configuration

obs_hours.note: Calendar spans are measurable; sampled rows are charging-only and not continuous watched time.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://github.com/BatICM/battery-charging-data-of-on-road-electric-vehicles; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
